CustomField.description: Boolean formula that returns TRUE when this donor's annual grouping is exactly Mid (not Entry, not Major). The three annual checkboxes (Entry / Mid / Major) are mutually exclusive — at most one is TRUE for any donor, matching FQS_Annual_Donor_Level__c. Uses the same annual-giving composition as FQS_Annual_Donor_Level__c (GiftsThisYearAmount, plus CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount when the Mid tier's Credit_Type__c = "Hard + Soft Credits"). Thresholds and Credit_Type are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Grouping or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold or Credit_Type values recalculates this field across all Donor Gift Summary records retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required. Reports and dashboards using this field will reflect the new values immediately.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. The field is checked when this donor's current-year giving qualifies for the Mid donor grouping. Your administrator controls the threshold amount.
CustomField.label: Is Mid Annual Donor
